name: Another Time Another Leaf -Kagami no Naka no Tantei-
original_name: Another Time Another Leaf 鏡の中の探偵
source:
The game is about a girl named Sakurane Kaede who finds a lookalike of herself inside a mirror her late mother gave her. Ageha has the power to travel into the near past, where she can investigate events and talk to people but cannot touch anything or bring it to the future with her. Kaede and Ageha use these powers to investigate the mysteries surrounding them.

[edited from [url=https://www.tehvidya.com/another-time-another-leaf-kagami-no-naka-no-tantei/]TehVidya[/url]]
translation:
游戏讲述少女樱音枫在已故母亲留给自己的镜子里，发现一个与自己容貌相同的人。扬羽拥有前往不久之前的能力，在那里可以调查事件、与人交谈，却无法触碰任何东西，也不能把物品带回未来。枫与扬羽利用这种能力，调查围绕在两人身边的种种谜团。

[编辑自[url=https://www.tehvidya.com/another-time-another-leaf-kagami-no-naka-no-tantei/]TehVidya[/url]]
